reason: This JVM runs without the BootUI agent. BootUI works without it; attach it with one of the setup snippets to add agent-based evidence.

snippets.label: Surefire and Failsafe
snippets.text:
<!-- In the maven-surefire-plugin and maven-failsafe-plugin configuration. @{argLine} keeps JaCoCo's
     agent; without JaCoCo, declare an empty <argLine/> property. -->
<configuration>
    <argLine>@{argLine} -javaagent:<rerun>/validation/.work/m2/com/julien-dubois/bootui/bootui-agent/1.19.0/bootui-agent-1.19.0.jar</argLine>
</configuration>
